column1: Evidence cells are live formulas: change Settings and they update. Severity: High = breaks a pillar or a GDD target, Medium = feel problem, Low = gap in the design.

column4: PROVISIONAL FIX APPLIED (2026-11-14): doors, serums and Reforger cost 2.5x, and ammo is bought at walls. Points now roughly match spending: the re-paced shopping plan keeps the bank near zero. But the GDD earning targets are still 2.5-3x below what players earn, and the first Reforger tier lands a bit later than the GDD's round 10-12.
column5: Earned by r5: 8,800, r10: 29,932, r20: 112,978 (GDD targets 3,000 / 12,000 / 40,000). Bank at r10: 5,242, r20: 677. Reforger I in round 13, Tier III in round 27.
column6: Update the GDD earning targets to the model (about 9,000 / 30,000 / 100,000). Play-test, then tune price_mult: 2.0 brings Reforger I closer to round 11. Wall guns and the Vault were left at old prices on purpose (safety net and loot).

column4: DECIDED: ammo is bought at wall guns, drops stay as they are. Ammo becomes the main late-game point sink: Reforged guns refill for 4000 (provisional), and by round 30 a full load lasts about a seventh of a round.
column5: Ammo spend as share of round points: r10 20%, r15 58%, r20 71%, r30 84%. Refills bought at r30: 6.6 per round.
column6: Watch in play-tests that walking to a wall 6-7 times a round at r30 is fun, not a chore. Levers: ammo_reforged price, Reforger reserve multiplier (x2 now), Scavenger serum ammo packs.

column4: DECIDED: Vault and loot guns have no wall, so every loot gun rolls one implicit ammo affix (Deep Reserve, Reclaimer or Fabricator; see Loot ammo tab, PROVISIONAL). The start pistol still has no wall and runs dry around round 3.
column5: At round 20, a Rare mako_pdw (Reforger tier 1) lasts 0.7 rounds with no affix; with an average implicit affix: Legendary 1.6, Common 0.9 rounds. Pistol alone at r3 needs 1.5x a full load.
column6: Loot guns are meant to need Reforger re-buys or Resupply late; Fabricator on Epic/Legendary is the 'sustain' build. Players are expected to buy a wall gun by round 3.

column4: The prototype's data files do not match the design: different gun damage, round count formula, linear health growth, and Runner/Walker types instead of the speed mix.
column5: 19 of 27 checked fields differ (see Sync tab).
column6: Decide which side wins per field. Recommended: the GDD numbers win, and P2 updates the .tres files and WaveRules formulas to match (count formula, x1.09 health from round 10, spawn delay x0.95).

column4: Atlas Auto (Uncommon) has by far the highest DPS in the game: about 1.7x the Vanguard AR and 1.6x the Rare Halberd LMG. Rarity does not track power.
column6: Atlas to 8 x 22 or 220 rpm, or move it to Rare. Note shotguns assume all pellets hit; add a pellet falloff to the model once ranges are known.

column4: Talon DMR is the most expensive wall gun but has lower DPS than the cheaper Kestrel SMG and Vanguard AR. Nothing in the design gives it a reason to exist except one-shotting early rounds.
column5: DPS per 1000 pts: Kestrel 638, Vanguard 583, Talon 400.
column6: Give the Talon penetration (hits 2-3 zombies in a line, good for training spots) or a 3.0x head multiplier.

column4: The Brenner Trench pump shotgun has only about 30% more sustained DPS than the free pistol once reloads count. It one-shots early, then falls off fast.
column6: Fine as a cheap early panic gun if that is the intent. Otherwise 90 rpm or 8 x 45.

column4: Gun power from item level grows far slower than zombie health. A round 30 loot gun hits 1.58x harder, but zombies have about 43x the health of round 1, so loot alone never feels like it keeps up.
column5: Round 30: health x42.8, loot gun + Tier III x4.7. Shots to kill with that gun: r20 7, r30 13.
column6: Intended pressure is fine, but consider ilvl_step 0.04 or a flat damage-per-ilvl tier table so a good drop clearly beats the wall gun.

column4: Loot volume is high. A run to run_round gives about 18 items (3x the 6-slot Pack) and a Legendary about every 3 runs, so a player reaching level 50 has seen around 45 Legendaries. Prototypes (the wonder weapons) come about once per 20 runs.
column5: Items per run: 18.5 vs 6 Pack slots. Runs per Legendary: 3.1, per Prototype: 21. Legendaries by level 50: 46.
column6: Lower the zombie drop chance (1.0% + 0.05%/round, max 3%) and count Vault guns separately from 'loot'. Keep Prototypes rare but add a pity: guaranteed after 30 Vault rolls without one.

column4: Sprinters (from round 15) and Stalkers are faster than your average move speed once the sprint cooldown is counted, so training loops get very tight late.
column5: Average player speed with sprint cycle: 5.81 m/s vs Sprinter 5.6 and Stalker 5.8 m/s. Zombies faster than walk at r20: 30%.
column6: Probably intended ('tense'). If late rounds feel unfair in play-tests, lower Sprint to 5.2 m/s or cap the Sprint share at 20%.

column4: The Brute's 12x health rides the exponential health curve. At round 27 it has over 45,000 health, and the head plate rule is unclear (head only, or all damage?).
column5: Brute health: r15 16,905, r27 47,549. Tier I AR body shots at r20: 217.
column6: Make the plate head-only, and use a flatter Brute curve (e.g. 12x up to round 20, then health grows 1.05 per round instead of 1.09).

column4: The crafting doc's income estimate is too low for this drop model: runs to round craft_round give 2-3x the Parts, Circuits and Fen Amber it assumed. Crafting goals then cost about half the runs the doc planned.
column5: Model / doc income: Scrap 1.5x, Parts 2.3x, Circuits 3.0x, Amber 3.2x. Goals off by more than 2x: 1 of 6.
column6: Either lower loot volume (the loot issue above), or raise material costs: Circuits and Amber about 2x.

column4: DECIDED (provisional, 2026-11-14): each map drops only its own set and 50% of Legendaries are set pieces. Before that, one set took about 150 runs.
column5: Runs to complete one set (one set per map): 30. If sets were shared across maps: 90. Level 50 takes about 139 runs.
column6: Watch in play-tests. If the loot drop-chance cut is adopted, Legendaries drop less often and sets get slower: re-check here.

column4: Attack damage is missing for Crawler, Bloater (melee), Brute and Glower, and Glower drops are not defined. These are assumed (yellow) in the Enemies tab.
column6: Add these to the design doc. Zombie damage does not scale with round in the design (the prototype adds 3%/round). Pick one.

column4: Luck is described ('shifts odds away from Common') but has no formula. The sheet uses a proposed rule.
column5: With luck 10% at round 15, Common drops from 55% to 52.6%.
column6: Adopt the proposed rule (non-Common shares x (1 + luck), then rescale) or write another into the GDD.

column4: The GDD has no reload times, and the Mako PDW burst rate is not defined. Reload times are assumed (yellow) and drive sustained DPS and TTK.
column6: Add reload (tactical and empty) per gun to the weapon list.

column4: The XP table in the GDD checks out against the formula. XP per run grows with round, so better players level much faster (by design).
column5: Level 10 in 3.4 runs, level 20 in 17, level 50 in 139 runs (run to round 15).
column6: No change needed. Watch the level 30-50 grind (about 100 more runs) in play-tests.
